Dallas, Texas12 contributions

The best tasting bowl of "pho" is here
Sep 2016 • Friends
Pho Thai Son, on 178 Le Lai, Q1, Saigon is the best "pho" I found anywhere around the world. This is the first place I go to eat when I come back to Viet Nam, if they are open. You can smell the "pho" as you walk in from the street. That is the difference between here and other "pho". There is no comparison because at other places you don't smell "pho" even when you sit down. The broth here is sweet with a boney stewed taste; that is the taste of true pho. It is also a clear broth indicating the broth is stewed, not brownish as you find at other places (probably from different broth). Another thing that makes great pho is the rice noodle is prepared right. If you don't prepared right the noodle will give its own flavor and spoil the broth. Do this, taste the broth as soon as you get it. Then mixed up the noodle as you squeeze in the lemon and add in Hoi Sin sauce and hot sauce (if you like); taste the broth again. Does it still taste the same? At other places around the world you will find the taste has changed indicating the noodle is not prepped right. Truly enjoy "pho" here; it is the best in my opinion. Beware this is not a fancy place; it is a local eatery.
